body: Fifth member of the Range Rover family revealed as a grand tourer

First glance at cabin: a warm, reductive space, inspired by contemporary interior design. Crafted for calm, with hidden technologies, sophisticated, tactile new materials and class‑leading second‑row legroom
A new expression of the grand tourer formula, created to deliver peerless long‑haul comfort, effortless performance and signature Range Rover breadth of capability
Prototype vehicles are now completing final global testing, wrapped in a camouflage design which highlights its sleek silhouette and coupé proportions
GAYDON, UK – 22 JULY 2026: Today, Range Rover confirms a fifth member of the family: Range Rover GT. A captivating new expression of Range Rover.

For the first time, the world is invited inside. The interior of Range Rover GT is shaped by the same reductive principles that define its exterior proportions: purity, precision and quiet modernity. The cabin features technology woven into its architecture, with a new single screen design paired with a driver display in place of a traditional instrument cluster. A concealed air vent runs across the width of the cabin, providing a clear horizontal graphic – an enduring Range Rover signature. A woven textile, part of a suite of beautiful materials, wraps the dashboard in a single, cohesive gesture – tactile, architectural, and designed to hide speakers within its form. Every element has been considered to create a sanctuary of calm, with a focus on reduced visual and acoustic noise and natural conversational access to more vehicle functions than ever before.

Range Rover GT will be the first all‑electric Range Rover from the new EMA platform, manufactured in Halewood, UK alongside ICE and hybrid models. Range Rover GT will be available as a battery electric vehicle (BEV) initially, with flexibility planned to be added to future vehicles through a full Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV) option later in the lifecycle.

The Range Rover GT will redefine the grand‑touring segment with the ability to deliver beautiful and engaging GT poise, proportions and long‑distance refinement while offering capabilities no conventional GT can match. We have spent the last few years working obsessively on the fundamentals of the GT formula, reinterpreted in a sophisticated, uniquely Range Rover way. The result is the most car‑like, yet unmistakably capable, Range Rover ever created, now possible on our electrified EMA architecture – complementing our existing powertrain portfolio to deliver a complete set of options for every customer need. Its blend of effortless EV performance, first‑class long‑haul refinement and all‑terrain capability is pure Range Rover; while its calming interior previews our vision of a modern grand tourer.

The result is the most car‑like, yet unmistakably capable, Range Rover ever created, now possible on our electrified EMA architecture – complementing our existing powertrain portfolio to deliver a complete set of options for every customer need. Its blend of effortless EV performance, first‑class long‑haul refinement and all‑terrain capability is pure Range Rover; while its calming interior previews our vision of a modern grand tourer.

Prototype vehicles are undertaking their final on‑road testing now, in a bespoke camouflage wrap designed by our in‑house creative teams. Inspired by the landscape surrounding Gaydon, the home of Range Rover's Creative and Engineering teams, the camouflage design uses local topographic contours as the basis for a flowing gold pattern that evokes the vehicle's grand touring character and sense of journey. Its digital aesthetic draws inspiration from the advanced technologies embedded within the vehicle, reinforcing Range Rover GT as the most technologically sophisticated Range Rover ever created.
More details about the new Range Rover GT will follow later this year.

Every Range Rover is curated for our clients – people who move with purpose, vision and integrity. With modernist design, serene and connected interiors, and effortlessly capable electrified performance, each vehicle offers a calm sanctuary that supports leadership in motion. Inspired by exemplary design since 1970.

The Range Rover family includes Range Rover, Range Rover Sport, Range Rover Velar and Range Rover Evoque. As part of our vision of modern luxury by design, every Range Rover is available as an electric hybrid, with fully electric models arriving before 2030.
Range Rover is one of the world’s leading British luxury brands, sold in 121 countries. It forms part of JLR's portfolio of distinctive British brands.

JLR is constantly seeking ways to improve the specification, design and production of its vehicles, parts and accessories and alterations take place continually. Whilst every effort is made to produce up‑to‑date literature, this document should not be regarded as an infallible guide to current specifications or availability, nor does it constitute an offer for the sale of any particular vehicle, part or accessory.
